Neither dead transition leaks reward or alters behavior. Against the example trace the RM behaves correctly: +0.1, +0.3, +1.0, 0 on the post-open key drop (key_lost correctly stays false because the door is open), and -2.0 on the box pickup, which the task forbids.

feedback:
All checks pass. Function set matches exactly the five declared propositions (blocker_moved, has_door_key, door_open, target_picked_up, key_lost) with no undeclared extras and no missing predicates.

1) blocker_moved: scans the grid for the unique door and tests the cell immediately to its start-side, env.grid.get(x-1, y), for a ball — equivalent to the documented check at (dx-1, dy). Ball in hand counts as moved (cell empty), re-dropping the ball on that cell makes it false again; other dropped objects do not falsely reset it. Short-circuiting means grid.get(x-1, y) is only evaluated for door cells, so no out-of-bounds access.
2) has_door_key: identical to the documented expression — carrying a key whose color matches a door in the grid.
3) door_open: identical to the documented scan for an open door.
4) target_picked_up: identical to the documented expression — carrying a box whose color matches env.mission, not assuming a fixed color.
5) key_lost: correctly implemented as an event. It reads env.episode_memory["previous_valuation"] read-only, compares prev['has_door_key'] against the current has_door_key and door_open expressions (inlined exactly as K and D), and requires the door closed now. The guard on the presence of previous_valuation is safe since the valuation is guaranteed complete; at the first step prev['has_door_key'] is False so the event is False. The one-step event semantics are respected (does not linger).

Persistent propositions use only current state; only key_lost consults the previous-step snapshot. No imports, no actions, no mutation of env or episode_memory, only documented API members (env.grid.get, env.width/height, env.carrying, env.mission, episode_memory), and all expressions are valid executable Python with proper None guards on cells. Boolean fidelity and constraint compatibility (door_open after blocker_moved/has_door_key, one-object carry, key_lost disjoint from has_door_key/door_open/target_picked_up) are consistent with the environment mechanics.
